title: Capitalise aisle section headings in ShoppingListDetailView
description: In ShoppingListDetailView.swift, apply .localizedCapitalized to the aisle name passed to AisleSectionHeader so raw lowercase names from aisle.conf (e.g. 'produce') render as 'Produce'. The nil-aisle 'Other' bucket is already capitalised and must be left unchanged. No file content is modified; this is a pure view-layer transform.
acceptance_criteria: AisleSectionHeader renders each aisle name via .localizedCapitalized ('produce' → 'Produce', 'canned' → 'Canned')
The nil-aisle 'Other' heading continues to display as 'Other'
Underlying .md file content (## produce) is unchanged
Multi-word aisle names (e.g. 'meat & fish') capitalise reasonably via .localizedCapitalized
